messages:
Maya: hey folks — planning a small LAN/steamdeck hang in the mezzanine Sat night. low-key, bring whatever you want to play. who needs to borrow a deck or battery pack?
Luis: i'm in. could use a battery pack — my deck dies in ~2hrs with WiFi + streaming. anyone got recommendations for portable PSUs?
Derek: Anker 65W packs are solid. i usually bring a 100W if i'm on-site cause multiple devices.
Kim: heads-up — if people plan to plug lots of laptops into the breaker, we should avoid space heaters and kettles :grimacing: Also, can someone bring an ethernet switch? WiFi might be flaky with 20 devices.
Maya: good call. Derek, can you bring your switch?
Derek: yup i've got a 5-port gigabit. i'll also bring a short CAT6 and label it.
Luis: poll time — vote for warm-up game: react with :one: for Rocket League, :two: for Jackbox, :three: for Among Us.
Kim: quick logistics Q — are we allowed to bring guests? not sure on access card rules on weekends.
OpsBot: Space policy reminder: mezzanine is available for internal events only. Guests must be escorted by an employee at all times. Please register visitors with People Ops ahead of time.
Maya: noted, we'll keep it internal unless someone registers.
Derek: i can bring spare controllers: 2x Xbox, 1x PS4, and 1 wired SN30 Pro. controllers are communal but please label if personal.
Luis: also have a spare USB-C->USB-A cable if anyone needs to hotplug a deck for charge.
Kim: meme alert — someone said "power strip olympics" when i mentioned adapters. please don't do power strip olympics. :joy:
Maya: haha noted. i'll bring a proper surge protector and some gaffer tape for cables.
Luis: who wants to try an impromptu mini-tourney for the Steam key i'm donating? small prize: honor of buying the next pizza.
Derek: i'm terrible but i'll enter for comedic value.
Maya: tallying volunteers. i'll post a tiny checklist tomorrow: controllers, chargers, switch, ethernet, surge protector, snacks. anyone wanna bring snacks besides me?
Kim: i got chips. maybe someone bring sweets for the late-night crowd.
Maya: perfect. see you Saturday ~18:30 setup, 19:00 start. closing time depends on cleanup.
Luis: thanks for organizing Maya! :heart:
